children: Shares of Corecivic fell after the company said its president and chief executive has resigned, citing health reasons.
The stock slid 7.5%, to $31.79, on Friday. Despite the loss, shares are up nearly 67% year to date.

The private prison operator before the bell said Patrick Swindle, who is pursuing treatment for stage-four metastatic pancreatic cancer, would step down after less than a year at the helm. He has also resigned from the company's board.
Lucibeth Mayberry, previously executive vice president and chief strategy officer, will now serve as president and CEO of the Brentwood, Tenn., company. Mayberry has been with CoreCivic since 2003.
